evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present a reproducible benchmark protocol, a public executable artifact, and a confirmatory live API evaluation that separate structural validity from task-specific correctness across five business workflow tasks and six Python implementation conditions: PydanticAI, LangGraph, DSPy, CrewAI, Agno, and a framework-free SDK reference.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models are increasingly used to extract records, generate SQL, summarize reports, answer policy questions, and route operational work.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Confirmatory analysis uses distinct task instances (100 extraction and 50 per other task, with three nested replicates) under a frozen analysis plan, yielding a 5400-row primary matrix with equivalence margins and Holm-adjusted contrasts against the SDK reference.
